definitions: Used to introduce a statement or question, often to express a certain attitude or to soften the impact of what is being said.
Used to indicate that what follows is an approximation or a generalization.
Used as a pause filler or to give the speaker time to think.
Used to emphasize a statement or to draw attention to a particular point.
examples: I was, like, so tired after work.
It was, like, five miles away.
And then, like, she just left.
He was, like, the best player on the team.
